customFields.title: Custom Fields
customFields.description: Manage your custom fields and configurations

productCompleteness.title: Completeness
productCompleteness.missingIntro: Add these before the product can be published:

deliveryRefund.title: Delivery refund
deliveryRefund.loadError: Could not load the delivery fee.
deliveryRefund.hint: Oja keeps the delivery fee, so a refund of it never comes off the shop's payout. Shops refund only items.

orderCancel.title: Cancel order
orderCancel.hint: Cancelling refunds the buyer {{amount}}, all that is left of this shop's order, and pays the shop nothing. The checkout's other orders are untouched.
orderCancel.told: The buyer is told by push and email why, and what is refunded.
orderCancel.cancelledOwed: Order cancelled. Paystack refused the refund: it is retried under Owed refunds.

owedRefunds.title: Owed refunds
owedRefunds.description: Refunds orders owe their buyers that Paystack refused or can't make. Each is retried 5 minutes, an hour and 6 hours after a refusal; after that, or under Paystack's ₦50 minimum, send it by hand and mark it settled.
owedRefunds.loadError: Could not load the owed refunds.
owedRefunds.empty: No order owes its buyer a refund.
owedRefunds.settleAmount: {{amount}} sent to the buyer by hand.
owedRefunds.notePlaceholder: The transfer's reference, or what was done
owedRefunds.settleHint: A settled refund is no longer retried. It still comes off the shop's payout.

perishable.title: Perishable
perishable.loadError: Could not load whether this is perishable.
perishable.categoryLabel: Products in this category are perishable
perishable.categoryHint: Perishable products, here and in its sub-categories, are delivered only by couriers arriving by the end of the next day. Shops can't change this.
perishable.inheritedFromParent: A parent category is perishable, so these products are perishable anyway.
perishable.productHint: Perishable products are delivered only by couriers arriving by the end of the next day. Shops can't change this.

productEnrichment.title: Enrichment
productEnrichment.loadError: Could not load where this product's fields came from.
productEnrichment.draftedIntro: AI drafted some fields. Check them before approving.

catalogueImport.title: Catalogue import
catalogueImport.description: Add products to the shared catalogue from a supplier's CSV. Each product is then enriched in the background and published once complete; each shop prices its own offer.
catalogueImport.loadError: Could not load the import settings.

upload.sourceHint: Who the file comes from. Its column mapping is remembered for the next file from the same source.
upload.fileHint: Comma, semicolon or tab separated, with a header row. Up to 500 rows.

mapping.minimum: Each row needs a title or a barcode, and a selling price.

preview.drafts: Rows with errors are skipped. Each product is enriched in the background: empty fields are filled from product databases, then it is published if complete, or sent for review when data came from an untrusted source.

results.enriching: Enrichment runs in the background. See Products → Enrichment for what was published or needs review.

catalogueEnrichment.title: Enrichment
catalogueEnrichment.description: What background enrichment did to imported products, and where each field came from. Spot-check what it published; fields marked AI draft must be checked before approving.
catalogueEnrichment.aiDraftHint: Drafted by AI from the product's photo and data. Check it before approving.
